dict.string: VIBEZCORE does not read your health data. Health access is only used to start a Mind & Body session on your Apple Watch during your Breathwork or State Control session.

VIBEZCORE starts a Mind & Body workout session on your Apple Watch while your Breathwork or State Control session runs. This opens the VIBEZCORE watch app when you start on your iPhone and keeps the guiding taps going while your wrist is down. VIBEZCORE does not save workouts or any other health data.
